title: Develop a complete brand identity
description: Propose two distinct creative territories with positioning, personality, tone, typography roles, palette and icon direction.
accomplishes: Propose two distinct creative territories with positioning, personality, tone, typography roles, palette and icon direction. Compare trade-offs and recommend one. Explain applications and checks; do not invent an official logo, trademark clearance or customer research.
prompt:
Act as a senior product designer.

Task: Develop a complete brand identity.

Input context:
- BUSINESS: [BUSINESS]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- VALUES: [VALUES]
- APPLICATIONS: [APPLICATIONS]

Propose two distinct creative territories with positioning, personality, tone, typography roles, palette and icon direction. Compare trade-offs and recommend one. Explain applications and checks; do not invent an official logo, trademark clearance or customer research.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Repair workshop concept
Direction A uses workshop signage, navy and orange for quotes and storefront wayfinding. Direction B uses editorial layouts, ivory and forest green for repair stories. Choose A if in-store orientation is the priority. Apply the system to a quote, card and service page. Verify name rights, reproduction and readability separately.
